en: Black‑and‑white interior view of a Protestant church, showing rows of wooden pews leading up to a simple altar with candelabras, plants, and a central cross motif. A large multi‑armed chandelier with candles hangs from the ceiling. Hymn boards flank the altar, and doors are set into the walls on either side. At the left is a tall slim clock and a pulpit with drapery. The architectural style is restrained and neoclassical. White printed captions identify the scene and photographer in Swedish.
